verifications.claim: Submitting IRS Form 4868 by April 15 provides an automatic six-month extension to file a federal tax return.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'filing a tax extension via Form 4868, which pushes the due date to October 15'; R2: 'request an extension... An extension gives people until October 15'; R3: 'six-month extension period'; R4: 'File Form 4868... until October 17'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm Form 4868 by April 15 grants automatic 6-month extension to October.

verifications.claim: The extension moves the filing deadline to October 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'pushes the due date to October 15' (article dated 2026/04/15 for 2025 taxes); R2: 'until October 15' with 'April 15, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify October 15 extension from April 15, 2026 deadline.

verifications.claim: The extension only applies to filing paperwork, not paying taxes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'does not mean an extension to pay'; R2: 'only for filing a return and not for extra time to pay'; R3: 'not an extension of time to pay'; R4: 'not an extension to pay'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly state extension is for filing only, not payment.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers must estimate and pay any taxes owed by April 15 to avoid penalties and interest.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'estimate your total liability... pay taxes by... April 15... to avoid penalties and interest'; R2: 'pay taxes due on April 15... to avoid penalties and interest'; R3: 'estimate... pay the amount due by the regular due date'; R4: 'pay taxes by April 18 to avoid penalties and interest'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for estimating and paying by deadline to avoid penalties/interest.

verifications.claim: All taxpayers can use IRS Free File to request an extension for free, regardless of income.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'IRS Free File... no income limit for extensions'; R2: 'All individual filers... regardless of income and at no cost'; R4: 'regardless of income, can use Free File... automatic tax-filing extension'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state no income limit and free for all via IRS Free File.

verifications.claim: Paying estimated tax due using Direct Pay, a debit/credit card, or digital wallet and selecting 'Extension' as the reason automatically files the extension.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'make a tax payment online and choose "extension"... automatically submits Form 4868'; R2: 'Pay online and select extension... online payment option'; R4: 'electronic payment with Direct Pay... debit, credit card or digital wallet and select... extension'
verifications.reasoning: Exact methods and 'extension' selection for automatic filing confirmed.

verifications.claim: Mailing a paper Form 4868 postmarked by April 15 files the extension.

verifications.claim: Failure to pay by April 15 can result in interest and penalties, even with an extension.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'pay taxes by... April 15... to avoid penalties and interest'; R2: 'pay taxes due on April 15... to avoid penalties and interest'; R3: 'owe interest... penalty for paying the tax late'; R4: 'pay taxes by April 18 to avoid penalties and interest'
verifications.reasoning: Consistent across sources that non-payment by deadline incurs penalties/interest despite extension.
